notes: Author's PROC COPY (memtype=data) migrating datasets from a 3.5 PostgreSQL schema to a 4.0 PostgreSQL schema. External DB servers are unreachable, so the two libnames are redirected to local base-engine directories and the source is seeded with two small mock tables (customers, accounts). The PROC COPY step is unchanged; PROC DATASETS and a PROC PRINT of the migrated customers table were added so the run has visible listing output (also makes the script self-contained for a /v1/quick demo).
